meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **online kurta sets** ke liye ye brands try kar sakti hain:

- **Libas** – Office wear aur daily wear ke liye reliable; cotton, straight-fit aur dupatta sets ka achha collection. Prices aksar ₹999–₹1,449 ke aas-paas milte hain.[7]
- **Biba** – Festive aur elegant ethnic styles ke liye; Flipkart par Biba ke kurta sets available hain.[2]
- **Aurelia** – Smart office wear, simple prints aur comfortable cuts ke liye.[2]
- **W for Woman** – Thode premium, polished designs aur work-to-festive outfits ke liye.[2]
- **GoSriKi** – Budget-friendly 3-piece kurta-pant-dupatta sets; rayon/viscose options kaafi milte hain.[1][5]
- **Indo Era** – Trendy printed, Anarkali aur straight kurta sets; usually affordable range mein.[5]
- **Vishudh** – Embroidered straight sets aur palazzo-dupatta combinations ke liye.[5]
- **Gerua by Libas** – Libas se zyada affordable, fashionable printed sets ke liye.[8]
- **Meesho sellers** – ₹200–₹500 ke budget mein bahut variety, lekin reviews, fabric aur return policy zaroor check karein.[4]
- **Nykaa Fashion brands** – Gahan, Vaamsi, DECKEDUP jaise brands ke stylish sets; sale mein ₹700–₹1,700 range mein options milte hain.[8]

**Quick recommendation:**
- **Best overall:** Libas  
- **Office wear:** Aurelia ya W for Woman  
- **Festive wear:** Biba ya Libas  
- **Budget shopping:** GoSriKi ya Meesho  
- **Trendy designs:** Indo Era ya Gerua by Libas  

Order karne se pehle fabric, size chart, customer photos aur return policy check karein—especially rayon sets mein fabric quality listing ke hisaab se kaafi vary kar sakti hai.
